notes: Other CAtool apps, such as GSTR-9 Desk, can now ask TallyDrop to open a client's company in the exact Tally release it belongs to. Dropping data on TallyDrop works as before. Includes the 1.0.1 and 1.0.2 fixes: client data on network shares whose path has spaces, Tally opening on the company list, and the "Application settings are lost" message caused by 1.0.0.
